about: The films shown on this public showcase (inventory of 10 Nov 2026; trimmed to 8 films the same day; Defence Factory added later that day). Other releases in this repository may be published but not shown. Durations, sizes and resolutions were measured with ffprobe from the release asset. Dates are when the film was first delivered. Rival films are named by lane or entry (A, B, C), without model or vendor names (POLICY). Films not yet approved for publication are listed in the private video-factory, not here.

families.name: Defence Factory
families.blurb: Agents prepare, people decide, the proof stays: security work done the agentic way on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.

families.name: AWS Factory
families.blurb: The AMI factory: one hardened base image, three workload families, proof in DEV before PROD.

families.name: Nextflow Offline
families.blurb: Scientific workflows prepared once and run offline, with evidence.

families.name: Agentic Pentest
families.blurb: Scanners, a tool-less AI and a policy gate that turn noise into reviewable findings.

videos.title: Defence Factory — Agents Prepare, People Decide
videos.summary: A 2:09 vision film in the toy world: a team drops in a security warning, agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore find every affected server and prepare one reviewed patch, a person approves once, and the proof goes to audit.

videos.title: AWS Factory — One Image, the Whole Loop
videos.summary: A 1:48 introduction to AWS Factory in the toy world: build only when something changed, prove on real test servers, rehearse the swap, approve, and feed findings back.

videos.title: Nextflow Offline — Prepare Once, Run with Confidence
videos.summary: One real nf-core Sarek test follows the whole journey: hosted and scanned in GitLab, prepared and verified in AWS, run on a sealed island with no internet, and proven with a PASS or FAIL report.
videos.notes: Rebuilt as three islands (mainland, vault, sealed island) with a failure drill. AI narration. Music: "Inspired" by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), CC BY 4.0.

videos.title: Nextflow Offline — Prepare Once, Run with Confidence
videos.summary: The first cut of the Nextflow Offline story in the cinematic night look: one missing piece stops an offline run, so everything is prepared, verified and run without a network.

videos.title: Agentic Pentest — What It Can Become
videos.summary: From a lab proof (480 alerts became 69 groups, and the AI has no tools) to a platform vision: every app tested every night by agents, checked by guardrails, judged by experts.
videos.notes: Revision 1 of this vision film was not released.

videos.title: Agentic Pentest POC — From Scanner Noise to Reviewable Findings
videos.summary: Six of 480 recorded scanner alerts travel through a tool-less model that may only propose, a five-check policy gate, and rule-based grouping into one evidence-preserving finding.

videos.title: Patching Running Servers in AWS Factory — Scanned Is Not Patched
videos.summary: How AWS Factory keeps running servers patched with Systems Manager Patch Manager: two roads, three families, the rules, and the trap of scanned-but-not-patched.

videos.title: CIS Hardening in AWS Factory — Fix What We Can, Accept What We Must
videos.summary: 243 CIS checks sort themselves into three buckets: hardened upstream, fixed by us, and accepted risk with owner approval in code, all ending at the release gate.

videos.title: Round 3 — BlueOps: the AMI Factory
videos.summary: An illustrative journey from a golden Amazon Linux 2023 image through a hardened base and three production families to DEV proof and a human-approved rollout.
